debug.command: npm install && cd ios && pod install && xcodebuild -workspace RNTest.xcworkspace -scheme RNTest -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -derivedDataPath build build

device.command: npm install && cd ios && pod install && xcodebuild -workspace RNTest.xcworkspace -scheme RNTest -configuration Debug -destination generic/platform=iOS -derivedDataPath build -allowProvisioningUpdates build

release.command: npm install && cd ios && pod install && xcodebuild -workspace RNTest.xcworkspace -scheme RNTest -configuration Release -destination generic/platform=iOS -archivePath build/App.xcarchive -allowProvisioningUpdates archive && xcodebuild -exportArchive -archivePath build/App.xcarchive -exportOptionsPlist "$MOBAI_EXPORT_OPTIONS" -exportPath build/ipa -allowProvisioningUpdates

simulatorRelease.command: npm install && cd ios && pod install && xcodebuild -workspace RNTest.xcworkspace -scheme RNTest -configuration Release -sdk iphonesimulator -derivedDataPath build build
